page: Microsoft Azure DC2eds_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEDV6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel processor with 2 dedicated vCPUs. It is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 118 GB NVMe SSD, and it is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

As a dedicated vCPU instance, the DC2eds_v6 provides predictable compute resources without CPU sharing. The inclusion of a local NVMe SSD provides fast local read and write capabilities, making it suitable for workloads requiring low-latency temporary storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers an entry-level point into the secure, memory-optimized DCEDV6 family, balancing a modest memory footprint with dedicated processing cores and high-speed local storage. This configuration is suited for small-scale database hosting, lightweight enterprise applications, secure microservices, and development or testing environments that require dedicated CPU allocation and fast local disk access.
